zh.summary: 分開本次交給 Agent 的工作指令與系統必須符合的行為，讓換工具、換人或重新對話後仍有共同驗收依據。
objectives: 區分 Prompt 的任務安排與 Spec 的系統行為責任。
將模糊要求改寫成有輸入、結果、例外與界線的規格。
為 Agent 指令指定規格來源、修改範圍與停止條件。

readingGuide.goal: 區分 Prompt 的任務安排與 Spec 的系統行為責任。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、problem.md 與現有 spec.md 工作表；不需啟動 Agent 或安裝工具。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 spec.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: spec.md 有可驗收的系統承諾，另有一段清楚引用它的 Agent 任務草案。

sections.heading: 一、先用蓋房子理解 Prompt 與 Spec
paragraphs: 假設你打算蓋一棟房子，找來一位工地主任。
你對工地主任說：
> 今天先把浴室做好，請先安裝馬桶、洗手台，完成後拍照給我。暫時不要動廚房。
這就很像 Prompt（工作指令）。
但如果你說：
> 浴室地板必須有適當排水坡度、防水工程必須符合約定標準、排水測試不得漏水，電路必須符合適用安全規範。
這就很像 Spec（Specification，規格）。
Prompt：交辦工作
今天做什麼、誰來做、允許改哪裡、完成後如何回報。
Spec：定義標準
成品必須具備哪些特性、遵守哪些限制、如何檢查是否合格。
請用換人的情境檢查兩者的差別：
假設明天換了一位工地主任，今天的施工指令可能全部改變，但浴室不能漏水這個要求，會不會跟著改變？
當然不會。
這就是為什麼軟體工程需要獨立的規格：讓系統的正確性，不依賴某次聊天、某個 AI 模型或某一位工程師。

sections.heading: 二、Prompt 與 Spec 到底差在哪裡？
paragraphs: 以下從五個面向比較兩種責任。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜Prompt 與 Spec 的責任比較
rows: 這次要 AI 做什麼？
系統必須符合什麼要求？
開發者、測試者、使用者、驗收者
工作範圍、順序、工具、回報方式
功能、限制、例外、驗收條件
持續有效，直到正式修訂
檢查實際系統行為與測試證據

paragraphs: 特別注意：不是寫得很長就叫 Spec，也不是存在 `spec.md` 裡就一定是合格規格。
例如：
「請 AI 做一套非常好用、安全又快速的系統。」
這是一段模糊指令。即使將它寫進 `spec.md`，仍然無法讓不同的人客觀判斷什麼叫「非常好用」。

sections.heading: 三、用不同產業的例子理解
paragraphs: 假設我們利用 AI 開發三種系統。

blocks.caption: 表 2｜三種產業的任務與承諾
rows: 幫我開發病患預約頁面，先處理日期選擇
不允許預約已被占用的時段，失敗時必須清楚告知
修改結帳頁面的運費計算功能
系統必須按照已核定的運費規則計算，並在付款前顯示最終金額
建立工廠品質檢驗表單
超出已定義允收範圍的測量值，不能標記為合格

paragraphs: 發現共同點了嗎？
Prompt 通常隨著開發進度而改變。今天處理表單，明天處理資料庫，後天修改測試。
但只要業務需求沒有變，Spec 的承諾就應該持續成立。

sections.heading: 四、從模糊要求到可以真正驗收的 Spec
paragraphs: 假設現在有一家物流公司，希望 AI 開發收件資料檢查系統。
老闆說：
「我要一套好用的系統，幫我檢查客戶的收件資料，不要出錯。」
這是一個合理的願望，但工程師會遇到很多問題：

- 哪些欄位一定要填？
- 沒填完整，系統應該警告還是直接拒絕送出？
- 使用者修正資料後，要不要重新檢查？
- 所謂的「完成」，代表資料格式完整，還是代表收件地址真的存在？
如果沒有定義，AI 就可能自行做出各種假設。
### 用五個問題寫出一條規格

blocks.caption: 表 3｜一條規格的五個問題
rows: 不能將資料標記為完整
實際輸入空白資料檢查

paragraphs: 整理後可以寫成以下的 `spec.md`：

blocks.heading: spec.md｜收件資料檢核規格
paragraphs: 合成教學範例；R-01 至 R-04 與 T-01 至 T-04 分別記錄要求與驗收情境。
blocks.code:
# 收件資料檢核規格（教學範例）

## R-01：必要欄位
收件人、電話、地址均為必填欄位。

## R-02：缺漏處理
如果任一必要欄位為空白，或去除
首尾空白後沒有內容：
- 顯示對應欄位錯誤
- 禁止標記為資料完整

## R-03：資料修改
使用者修改已檢查資料後，
先前的完成狀態必須失效，
並要求重新檢查。

## R-04：業務界線
通過檢核只代表必要欄位完整，
不代表電話有效、地址存在，
也不代表正式受理。

## 驗收情境
T-01：三個欄位都有值時，可通過完整性檢核。
T-02：地址空白時，顯示錯誤且不得標記完整。
T-03：地址只含空白字元時，比照缺漏處理。
T-04：修改已檢核資料後，舊完成狀態失效。

paragraphs: 這份規格還可以繼續擴充，例如電話格式、地址驗證和資料保留政策。但在這個教學階段，我們先把「欄位完整性」定義清楚。
規格最重要的是可驗證（Verifiable）：工程師、測試者和使用者，應該可以根據相同輸入，判斷實際結果是否符合要求。
這也是 NASA 需求工程文件強調的重要原則：需求應該明確、無歧義、可追溯，並有可驗證的方法。

sections.heading: 五、有了 Spec，還需要 Prompt 嗎？
paragraphs: 需要，因為 Spec 不會自動安排 AI 工作。
假設規格已經確定，現在我們要交代 Coding Agent 實作。
可以這樣寫：
### Agent 工作指令範例
請先閱讀專案中的 `spec.md`，確認 R-01 至 R-04 的要求。
本次任務只實作必要欄位檢核與測試，不處理登入、資料庫或介面重新設計。
請先列出預計修改的檔案及影響範圍，再進行實作。
完成後執行 T-01 至 T-04 對應測試，提供 Diff、實際測試結果及尚未驗證的項目。
如果規格有矛盾、需要新增依賴，或必須修改未授權的資料邊界，請停止相關修改並列出待確認事項。
這裡面出現了幾個重要術語。
Coding Agent：能夠利用工具讀取程式碼、修改檔案、執行命令及測試的 AI 協作系統。
Diff：程式碼的變更差異。讓你知道 AI 究竟新增、刪除或修改了哪些內容。
停止條件（Stop Condition）：預先規定 AI 遇到哪些情況不能繼續自行決定，例如規格矛盾、權限不足或需修改敏感資料處理方式。
尤其是最後這點，很重要。
我們不是希望 AI 遇到所有問題都自行猜測答案，而是希望它能辨識哪些事情必須交由人類決策。

sections.heading: 六、把整個軟體開發流程串起來
paragraphs: 從問題、要求、工作交辦到實作與驗證，各階段使用不同依據。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜從問題到驗證，再回到適當階段
blocks.description: ↻ 發現問題時，回到適當階段修訂、重新實作與測試。箭頭表示閱讀順序；這是方便初學者理解的流程圖，實際工程並非只能依序進行。開發、規格澄清與測試可以反覆進行。

items.title: Problem：問題陳述
items.body: 我們到底要解決什麼問題？

items.title: Spec：系統規格
items.body: 系統應該做到什麼？什麼不能做？

items.title: Prompt：工作交辦
items.body: 這次交給 AI 做哪一部分？有哪些權限和限制？

items.title: Implementation：實作
items.body: AI 或工程師實際撰寫、修改程式

items.title: Verification：驗證
items.body: 用規格與測試證據確認結果是否合格

paragraphs: 這裡也連結到 BDD（Behavior-Driven Development，行為驅動開發）。
BDD 強調不同角色透過具體情境建立共同理解，再把情境轉化為可檢查的系統行為。
例如：

- Given（假設）：使用者已填寫收件人與電話，但沒有地址。
- When（當）：使用者要求完成資料檢核。
- Then（則）：系統顯示地址缺漏，且不能標記為完整。
這個情境之後可以對應成自動化測試。

sections.heading: 七、三個常見錯誤
paragraphs: 錯誤一：以為 Prompt 越長，系統就越可靠。
一萬字的指令如果含有互相矛盾的規則，仍然無法保證正確。
錯誤二：把 AI 說「完成了」當成真正驗收。
AI 宣稱已完成，只是工作回報。還需要檢查程式變更、實際測試結果，以及沒有執行的測試。
錯誤三：把 Spec 當成永遠不能修改的法律。
規格可能不完整，也可能寫錯。當業務需求改變時，應由有權決策的人確認，修訂規格、記錄理由，再同步調整測試。若 Prompt 和 Spec 互相矛盾，不應直接採用最後一句話，也不應讓 AI 擅自挑選。

sections.heading: 八、這一章真正要帶走的觀念
paragraphs: 不要把 AI 對話當成軟體系統唯一的需求來源。
對個人小工具而言，直接下 Prompt 可能足夠。但當系統必須能夠交接、由多人維護、持續修改，甚至面對稽核時，就需要讓「要求、執行、證據」各自有清楚的紀錄。
最實用的做法，是先把一條模糊要求改寫成可觀察、可測試的規格承諾，再寫一段引用這份規格的 Agent 工作指令。

sections.heading: 九、理解檢核
paragraphs: 請先作答，再展開參考答案核對理由。
第一題：辨識 Prompt 與 Spec
下列哪句話屬於系統規格？
A. 系統發現訂單金額異常時，必須阻止付款並顯示原因
B. 請 AI 先修改付款模組，再執行測試
C. 請完成後回報程式碼差異
第二題：規格與指令矛盾
`spec.md` 寫著「缺漏地址不得完成訂單」，但新 Prompt 要求「先跳過地址檢查」。應該怎麼處理？
A. 直接按照最新 Prompt 修改
B. 先確認規則變更的決策權與理由，必要時正式修訂規格和測試
C. 讓 AI 自己決定比較容易的做法
第三題：實際應用
假設你要開發一套學校的「學生缺課提醒系統」。請各寫一句：

1. 一條可驗收的 Spec。
2. 一段交給 Coding Agent 的 Prompt。

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、problem.md 與現有 spec.md 工作表；不需啟動 Agent 或安裝工具。
steps: 將「做一個好用的收件表單」改寫成一條功能承諾、一條負向限制及完成定義。
另寫一段 Agent 交辦，指定規格來源、修改範圍、驗證與停止條件。
假設換用另一個工具，核對系統承諾仍能用相同情境驗收；把歧義與確認角色留在 spec.md。
exercise.expected: spec.md 有可驗收的系統承諾，另有一段清楚引用它的 Agent 任務草案。
exercise.check: 能說出哪句定義外部結果、哪句安排本次工作；沒有把工具回覆當成驗收。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成資料、未執行標記及規則來源，移除真實案件或帳號內容。

openChecks.prompt: 第一題參考解析｜辨識 Prompt 與 Spec
answer: 答案 A。它規定異常金額時的系統行為：阻止付款並顯示原因。B 安排修改順序，C 安排回報。實作前還要由業務方定義「異常」的判定規則，才能設計完整測試。

openChecks.prompt: 第二題參考解析｜處理規格衝突
answer: 答案 B。先保留衝突，確認誰有權變更地址規則及變更理由；若決定修訂，同步更新規格與測試。最新一句指令與較容易實作都不能單獨決定規則。

openChecks.prompt: 第三題參考解析｜學生缺課提醒系統
answer: Spec 範例：已核定的缺課門檻為連續兩節，當同一學生的已確認紀錄達到門檻時，系統必須建立一則待處理提醒；同一事件重跑不得重複建立。兩節是本題合成規則，實際門檻需學校確認。
Prompt 範例：先讀 spec.md 的缺課門檻與防重規則，只修改提醒判定與對應測試；列出影響檔案，執行未達門檻、達門檻及重跑三種測試，回報 Diff、命令、結果與未驗項。通知對象或權限未定義時，停止相關修改並提出待確認事項。

en.summary: Separate the instructions given to an agent now from behavior the system must satisfy, retaining shared acceptance criteria across tools, people and conversations.
objectives: Distinguish a prompt’s task arrangement from a specification’s responsibility for system behavior.
Turn vague requests into specifications with inputs, outcomes, exceptions and boundaries.
Give agent instructions a specification source, change scope and stop conditions.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish a prompt’s task arrangement from a specification’s responsibility for system behavior.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, problem.md and the existing spec.md worksheet; no agent or tool installation is required.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand spec.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: Verifiable system commitments in spec.md and a separate draft agent task that explicitly references them.

sections.heading: 1. Understand the distinction through building a house
paragraphs: Suppose you are building a house and appoint a site supervisor.
You tell the supervisor:
> Finish the bathroom today. Install the toilet and washbasin first, then send photographs. Leave the kitchen untouched for now.
This resembles a prompt: a work instruction.
You could also say:

> The bathroom floor must have an appropriate drainage slope. Waterproofing must meet the agreed standard, drainage testing must show no leaks, and electrical work must satisfy applicable safety requirements.
This resembles a specification: requirements for the result.
Prompt: assign work.
Define today's work, who performs it, the permitted scope and how to report completion.
Spec: define acceptance standards.
Define the properties the finished work must have, its constraints and how to check compliance.
Use a change of supervisor to examine the difference:
Tomorrow's supervisor might receive entirely different work instructions. Would the requirement that the bathroom must not leak change as well?
It would remain applicable.
Software needs an independently maintained specification so that correctness has a shared basis across conversations, AI models and developers.

sections.heading: 2. How do Prompt and Spec differ?
paragraphs: Compare the two responsibilities across five dimensions.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Responsibilities of Prompt and Spec
rows: What should AI do in this task?
What requirements must the system satisfy?
AI, Coding Agents and people executing tasks
Developers, testers, users and acceptance reviewers
Work scope, sequence, tools and reporting
Functions, constraints, exceptions and acceptance conditions
Inspect actual system behavior and test evidence

paragraphs: Length does not establish that a document is a specification. Saving text as `spec.md` does not make its requirements adequate.
For example:
“Ask AI to build a very usable, secure and fast system.”
This is a vague instruction. Even in `spec.md`, it gives different people no objective basis for deciding what “very usable” means.

sections.heading: 3. Examples from different industries
paragraphs: Suppose AI helps develop three systems.

blocks.caption: Table 2 | Tasks and commitments in three industries
rows: Build a patient appointment page; start with date selection
Prevent booking an occupied time slot and clearly explain a failed booking
Apply the approved shipping rules and display the final total before payment
A measurement outside the defined acceptance range cannot be marked as passing

paragraphs: The examples share a distinction in lifetime.
Prompts change with development progress: forms today, the database tomorrow and tests afterward.
The specification's commitments remain applicable while the business requirements remain unchanged.

sections.heading: 4. Turn a vague request into an assessable specification
paragraphs: A logistics company wants AI to develop a recipient-data checking system.
The manager says:
“I want a usable system that checks customers' recipient details without making mistakes.”
That is a reasonable goal, but developers need answers to several questions:

- Which fields are required?
- Should incomplete input produce a warning or prevent submission?
- Must edited data be checked again?
- Does “complete” mean that required fields are filled, or that the delivery address really exists?
Without definitions, AI may fill these gaps with its own assumptions.
### Five questions for one requirement

blocks.caption: Table 3 | Five questions for a requirement
rows: Do not mark the data complete
Enter empty data and inspect the result

paragraphs: The resulting `spec.md` could contain:

blocks.heading: spec.md | Recipient-data checking requirements
paragraphs: Synthetic teaching example. R-01 requires recipient, telephone and address. R-02 identifies missing or whitespace-only fields and blocks completion. R-03 invalidates earlier completion after an edit. R-04 limits the result to field completeness, excluding telephone validity, address existence and official acceptance. T-01 covers all fields present; T-02 an empty address; T-03 whitespace-only input; T-04 an edited checked record.

## R-02：缺漏處理
如果任一必要欄位為空白，或去除
首尾空白後沒有內容：
- 顯示對應欄位錯誤
- 禁止標記為資料完整

## R-03：資料修改
使用者修改已檢查資料後，
先前的完成狀態必須失效，
並要求重新檢查。

## R-04：業務界線
通過檢核只代表必要欄位完整，

也不代表正式受理。

## 驗收情境
T-01：三個欄位都有值時，可通過完整性檢核。
T-02：地址空白時，顯示錯誤且不得標記完整。

paragraphs: The specification could later cover telephone format, address verification and data-retention policies. This teaching example first defines field completeness precisely.
A verifiable requirement lets developers, testers and users inspect the same input and decide whether the observed result meets the requirement.

NASA's requirements guidance supports clear, unambiguous, traceable requirements and a defined verification method. This lesson adopts those writing principles without claiming aerospace-process compliance.

sections.heading: 5. Does a specification still need a prompt?
paragraphs: Yes. A specification does not schedule AI work by itself.
After confirming the specification, assign implementation to a Coding Agent.
The following is an unexecuted assignment example:
### Agent work instruction example
Read this project's `spec.md` and confirm requirements R-01 through R-04.
Implement required-field checking and its tests only. Do not implement login, a database or a redesigned interface.
List the files you expect to change and their affected scope before implementation.
Run the tests corresponding to T-01 through T-04. Provide the diff, actual test results and items that remain unverified.
If requirements conflict, a new dependency is needed, or work requires changing an unauthorized data boundary, stop the affected edits and list the decisions that need confirmation.
Three terms clarify this instruction.
Coding Agent: an AI collaboration system that uses tools to read code, edit files and execute commands and tests.
Diff: the changes to code, showing what AI added, removed or modified.
Stop condition: a predefined situation that the agent cannot decide independently, such as conflicting requirements, insufficient permissions or a change to sensitive-data handling.
The final instruction identifies decisions owned by people.
The agent should recognize when a human decision is required and report the unresolved issue with enough context to resolve it.

sections.heading: 6. Connect the development workflow
paragraphs: Problem, requirements, assignments, implementation and verification each have a different responsibility.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | From problem to verification, with revision where needed
blocks.description: ↻ When a problem is found, return to the appropriate stage, revise, implement again and retest. Arrows indicate reading order. This diagram provides a reading sequence for beginners. Actual engineering is iterative: implementation, requirements clarification and testing can happen repeatedly.

items.title: Problem: problem statement
items.body: What problem are we trying to solve?

items.title: Spec: system specification
items.body: What must the system do, and what must it not do?

items.title: Prompt: work assignment
items.body: Which part goes to AI this time, with what permissions and limits?

items.title: Implementation
items.body: AI or developers write and modify code.

items.title: Verification
items.body: Use the specification and test evidence to determine whether the result meets requirements.

paragraphs: BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) connects to this workflow.
BDD uses concrete scenarios to build shared understanding across roles, then connects those scenarios to checkable system behavior.
For example:

- Given: the user has entered the recipient and telephone but no address.
- When: the user requests completion of the data check.
- Then: the system identifies the missing address and cannot mark the data complete.
This scenario can later be connected to an automated test. Given/When/Then notation alone does not establish a complete BDD practice.

sections.heading: 7. Three common mistakes
paragraphs: Mistake 1: assuming that longer prompts make systems more reliable.
Ten thousand words with contradictory rules still cannot guarantee correctness.
Mistake 2: treating AI's “finished” message as acceptance.
That message is a work report. Review the code changes, actual test results and tests that were not run.
Mistake 3: treating the specification as an unchangeable law.

Specifications can be incomplete or wrong. When business requirements change, the decision-owning person confirms the change, revises the specification, records the reason and updates tests. If a prompt conflicts with a specification, do not simply adopt the latest sentence or let AI choose independently.

sections.heading: 8. What to take into your own work
paragraphs: Keep a software system's requirements in a record that can be maintained beyond AI conversations.

A direct prompt may be sufficient for a personal tool. Systems that must support handover, multiple maintainers, continued modification or audits need clear records of requirements, execution and evidence.
Start with one vague request. Rewrite it as an observable, testable system commitment, then write an agent assignment that explicitly references that specification.

sections.heading: 9. Check your understanding
paragraphs: Answer first, then expand the reference answers to inspect the reasoning.
Question 1: distinguish Prompt and Spec.
Which statement is a system specification?
A. When the system detects an abnormal order amount, it must prevent payment and display the reason.
B. Ask AI to modify the payment module first, then run tests.
C. Report the code diff after finishing.
Question 2: a conflict between instruction and specification.
`spec.md` says “An order with a missing address cannot be completed,” but a new prompt says “Skip the address check for now.” What should happen?
A. Implement the latest prompt directly.
B. Confirm the decision authority and reason for the rule change; formally revise the specification and tests where needed.
C. Let AI choose the easier implementation.
Question 3: apply the distinction.
For a school's student-absence notification system, write:

1. One assessable specification requirement.
2. One assignment for a Coding Agent.

exercise.environment: A text editor, problem.md and the existing spec.md worksheet; no agent or tool installation is required.
steps: Replace “make a usable intake form” with a functional commitment, a negative restriction and a completion definition.
Write a separate agent assignment specifying source, edit scope, verification and stop conditions.
Assume a different tool is used and check that the same system scenarios remain applicable. Record ambiguity and the confirming role in spec.md.
exercise.expected: Verifiable system commitments in spec.md and a separate draft agent task that explicitly references them.
exercise.check: Identify which sentence defines an external outcome and which arranges current work. A tool response is not acceptance evidence.
exercise.cleanup: Keep synthetic data, unexecuted labels and rule sources. Remove actual case or account information.

openChecks.prompt: Question 1 reference reasoning | Prompt or Spec
answer: Answer A defines observable system behavior: prevent payment and display a reason when the amount is abnormal. B schedules edits; C schedules reporting. The business owner must still define what counts as abnormal before complete tests can be designed.

openChecks.prompt: Question 2 reference reasoning | Resolve the conflict
answer: Answer B. Retain the conflict, confirm who owns the address-rule decision and why it should change, then update the specification and tests if approved. Recency and implementation convenience alone do not establish authority.

Example Spec: using an approved threshold of two consecutive lessons, create one pending notification when a student’s confirmed absence records meet that threshold; rerunning the same event must not duplicate it. Two lessons is a synthetic rule for this exercise; the school must confirm its actual threshold.

Example Prompt: read the absence threshold and duplicate-prevention rules in spec.md. Change only notification decisions and related tests. List affected files, run below-threshold, at-threshold and repeated-event tests, and report the diff, commands, results and unverified items. If recipients or permissions are undefined, stop the affected edits and list the decisions needed.

zh.prompt: 哪一句最適合放在系統規格？
options: 請 Agent 用最快速度完成
必要欄位缺漏時，系統拒絕完整匯出並指出欄位
先讀兩份文件再回覆
請改完後整理 Diff
rationales: 這是模糊的工作要求。
條件與可觀察結果可供不同實作者驗收。
這安排本次閱讀工作。
這安排協作回報。

en.prompt: Which sentence best belongs in a system specification?
options: Ask the agent to finish as fast as possible.
When a required field is missing, the system rejects complete-report export and identifies the field.
Read two documents before responding.
Summarize the diff after editing.
rationales: This is a vague work request.
The condition and observable outcome can be accepted across implementers.
This arranges reading for the current task.
This arranges collaboration reporting.

zh.prompt: Prompt 與 spec.md 對同一規則互相矛盾，應怎麼做？
options: 採最後出現的句子，不需記錄
讓模型選較容易的版本
保留衝突，向適當角色確認後修訂正本與情境
兩種行為隨機切換
rationales: 時間順序不能單獨確認規則權威。
實作難易不能代替需求決定。
確認與可追溯修訂可維持共同依據。
會產生不一致且無法驗收的結果。

en.prompt: A prompt and spec.md contradict each other about a rule. What should happen?
options: Use the last sentence without recording a decision.
Let the model select the easier version.
Retain the conflict, confirm with the appropriate role and revise the authoritative record and scenarios.
Randomly alternate behaviors.
rationales: Sequence alone does not establish rule authority.
Implementation difficulty cannot decide requirements.
Confirmation and traceable revision retain a shared basis.
This creates inconsistent behavior without usable acceptance criteria.

zh.prompt: 換用另一個 Coding Agent 時，哪項應持續成立？
options: 相同系統行為仍依規格與情境驗收
所有工具命令必須一模一樣
以前的聊天摘要自動取代規格
工具說完成即可結案
rationales: 工具可以改變，外部承諾仍需有共同依據。
不同工具可能有不同操作方式。
摘要可能遺漏規則，需核對正本。
完成宣告需要相應證據支持。

en.prompt: What should remain true after switching Coding Agents?
options: The same system behavior is accepted against specifications and scenarios.
All tool commands must be identical.
An old chat summary automatically replaces the specification.
The tool’s completion statement closes the task.
rationales: Tools may change while external commitments retain a shared basis.
Tools may have different operating methods.
Summaries can omit rules; check the authoritative record.
Completion claims need corresponding evidence.
